text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Nothing beats this when you're tired! 
Tsuyoshi-brand Health Drink No. 11!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"It's a magical drink made by gathering 
every single healthy-looking ingredient I 
could find!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Well, this has a rather unique smell, 
so I can only drink it in open spaces like 
this.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"It's made with only healthy ingredients! 
Taste and smell don't matter one bit!!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Hm... Trainer, you've been staring. Could 
it be... you're interested?
